Execution-scoped transactions now read the retirement hold under the ownership lock their transaction already holds; host/API stores keep the UPDATE. Selection covers execution-worker chat create/unarchive, the retirement hold and its serialization on both dialects, a fresh real Core first chat, the host guard, and the existing worker chat-acceptance and handoff cases that were red on main because of this defect.
exclusions: No UI, native, or frontend code changed, so no frontend, native, or Playwright tests. PostgreSQL parametrizations run because test_shutdown_readmission.py is selected. The longer real-Core shutdown/reopen case is not selected; the new fresh-Core case covers its first-chat step. No live or staging Core mutation, database backup, or deployment.
